text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaaa-hoo~ I got super bored so I came
over.
My outing plans got totally blown off,
what a rip! Hey, pay attention to meee!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Are you headed out?
And wow,
that bag is huge! So long!
Whatcha got in there~?

I readjust the "bag" she's talking about—
a billiards cue case.
A colleague recently introduced me to the game,
and I got hooked.
choice_data_list: I'm heading out to play some billi...
I'm heading out to play some billi...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat!
Look at that super fun grin on your
face~!!
No fair, no fair, no fairrr!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Which means... I can come too, right?
I can,
right?
Take me with you♡ ...Pleeeaaase take meee♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! It's so lively in here!!
I wanna play already, let's go, let's go!!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, do you even k...
Come to think of it, do you even k...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I've seen it played before, maybe~?
So how 'bout you show me how it's done first!
Come on, come on~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!! Lookin' good! Keep goin'...
keep goin'...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So clooose~!!
You just needed to sink that ball,
right? Seriously so close~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, mmhmm, gotcha. Well then...
Let me try, let me try! Hey,
pass me the cue♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is pocket this "9-ball," right?
Alrighty~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Line it up careee-fully... caaaare-fully...
aaand... yaaay♡

(CLACK! ...Rattle, rattle,
rattle............ THUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
S-Seriously?!
Pocketing the 9-ball on the break...
She's a beginner,
right?! A break-and-run right off the bat,
are you kidding me—

text_block_list.name: Man in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a beginner pulled off that shot?!
...Excuse me, miss! Young lady over there,
a moment please!

The man in the suit holds out a business
card.
According to what's written on it, he is—

text_block_list.name: Former Pro
text_block_list.text:
You were born to go pro!
I know someone who's fantastic at coaching,
so if you're interested...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Gosh, I really am super popular,
aren't I~♡
......Well, but still.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sorry, no can do♡

In the end, she turned down the scout.
He muttered about what a waste of talent it
was, though...
choice_data_list: You've got races to focus on, so y...
You've got races to focus on, so y...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, well, that's part of it right now,
sure.
Even without that,
I totally would've said no anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
stuff like this happens to me all the
time~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like when I went to that plushie sewing
class...
On my very first day,
they used mine as the example—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And when I tried oil painting just for
fun,
I ended up winnin' first place in some
contest—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and I tried out target shooting once
too!
My first score beat the instructor's!
And tons of other stuff too—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Point is, I try out all kinds of things,
but I pick 'em up right away,
and then get bored of 'em instantly.
Always.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So judging by today,
billiards would probably end up the same way,
y'know?
choice_data_list: It really hits home how naturally ...
It really hits home how naturally ...

text_block_list.text:
Even so,
as someone who took up pool as a hobby,
I can't just take this loss lying down.
Even if she is a genius—
choice_data_list: Let's play again sometime! I'll ge...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wait! Just now, you were... wait,
how?!
You were, like,
sooooo crazy sparkly just now?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's the deal,
why only you?! That's so not fair!
I wanna sparkle tooooo~~~~~!!

I'm not quite sure what she means by
"sparkle"...
but from how things have gone,
maybe Fusaichi Pandora just wants a hobby
she can be passionate about.
choice_data_list: Then how about we look for a hobby...
Then how about we look for a hobby...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You mean something completely new?
With you? ...Hmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Alright, let's do it~!!
You better make sure I get to sparkle too,
okay?♡
